description: Qwen Code 0.28.0 in -p mode with --approval-mode yolo: one run_shell_command call (cat hello.txt), then the answer; traces with prompts.
notes: Qwen Code is a Gemini CLI fork. Its telemetry is set in .qwen/settings.json as IN7.3 writes it, with no hooks; the header line is in .qwen/.env. The model is served by the mock as an OpenAI chat endpoint (OPENAI_BASE_URL). The shell tool is run_shell_command, whose only required parameter is command. Qwen's background memory agents (extraction, dream, skill review) are off: each makes model calls after the answer that the scripted turns do not cover, so the settings's memory block turns them off. span_names keeps the three qwen-code spans: the undici HTTP spans that Qwen's client also emits carry the loopback peer address (network.peer.address 127.0.0.1), which the leak check refuses. Volatile: gen_ai.conversation.id, session.id and qwen-code.prompt_id are random per run. Timing: duration_ms, interaction.duration_ms, gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk, ttft_ms, output_tokens_per_second, sampling_ms, request_setup_ms and retry_total_delay_ms are measured; gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages and qwen-code.context.usage differ between runs (the system prompt carries the memory catalog, the date and the token breakdown of the context), so the check ignores their values.
